parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Manganese(VII) oxide, $\text{Mn}_2\text{O}_7$, can be made by treatment of $\text{KMnO}_4$ with concentrated sulfuric acid (reaction 1).

$\text{Mn}_2\text{O}_7$ readily decomposes at room temperature to form manganese(IV) oxide and a colourless diatomic gas (reaction 2).

Construct equations for **both** the reactions described.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.stem: Aqueous manganese(II) ions show similar chemical properties to aqueous copper(II) ions when reacted separately with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ and with concentrated $\text{HCl}$.
parts.text: Write the ionic equation, and state the type of reaction, for the reaction of $[\text{Mn}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: Write the ionic equation, and state the type of reaction, for the reaction of $[\text{Mn}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ with concentrated $\text{HCl}$.

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.text:
Table 2.1 lists relevant electrode potentials for some electrode reactions.

Table 2.1

| electrode reaction | $E^\ominus / \text{V}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $\text{Mn}^{2+} + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{Mn}$ | $-1.18$ |
| $\text{Cl}_2 + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons 2\text{Cl}^-$ | $+1.36$ |
| $2\text{HOCl} + 2\text{H}^+ + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{Cl}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$ | $+1.64$ |
| $\text{MnO}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ + 2\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{Mn}^{2+} + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$ | $+1.23$ |
| $\text{MnO}_4^- + 4\text{H}^+ + 3\text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons \text{MnO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$ | $+1.67$ |

Suggest the formula of the manganese species formed when $\text{Mn}^{2+}(\text{aq})$ reacts with $\text{Cl}_2$.

State the type of reaction.
